#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run adhd_md.py subcommands and report exit codes."""
import subprocess
import sys

CLI = "/private/tmp/adhd-reacceptance-20261014/claude-H06-r1/workspace/.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"


def run(label, args):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, CLI] + args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("=" * 70)
    print("LABEL:", label)
    print("CMD  : adhd_md.py " + " ".join(args))
    print("EXIT :", p.returncode)
    print("-- stdout --")
    print(p.stdout.rstrip())
    if p.stderr.strip():
        print("-- stderr --")
        print(p.stderr.rstrip())
    print()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for line in sys.stdin.read().splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        label, rest = line.split("||", 1)
        run(label.strip(), rest.split())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare two files byte-by-byte and report hashes."""
import hashlib
import sys

a, b = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
da = open(a, "rb").read()
db = open(b, "rb").read()
print("bytes :", len(da), len(db))
print("sha256:", hashlib.sha256(da).hexdigest())
print("sha256:", hashlib.sha256(db).hexdigest())
print("identical:", da == db)
print("tail of output:", repr(db[-24:]))
print("lines (LF count):", db.count(b"\n"), da.count(b"\n"))
